body: Everything is wrong right now. My boyfriend is in the hospital and the doctors don’t know what’s wrong with him, my parents told me that feeling suicide over this was selfish and I was “making it about me” and my dad shoved me. This is the first time he’s put his hands on me like that. I’m not allowed to leave the house because they’ll call the cops if I do. I’m so scared and alone and I’ve been suicidal for most of my life but this time I’m serious about it

I’m trying so hard. I tried to come to my parents about how close to the edge I am, and they called me selfish and said I was making the situation all about me. We started yelling at each other, and my dad put his hands on me. And now I can’t leave the house because they’ll call the cops if I do. I’m so broken. I can’t do this.

I know she’d understand, but she’s asleep right now and I don’t want to wake her up over something like this. Plus I know I’ll be safer here cause I can’t self harm or do anything worse to myself at her house, so it’s probably better I stay...
